question: Which power there is enjoyer, Shambhu, supreme lord, and what triad unites in meditation?
premises: enjoyer-feminine there, but which power, he Shambhu supreme lord
inference: The enjoyer-power is Shambhu supreme; atom-power-self meditated unites the triad.
plain_english: Enjoyer-feminine there, but which power, he Shambhu, supreme lord — atom-power-shiva-self-thus, having meditated, united triad.
